rows.grounds: ṣaṭsu = in-six; locative plural form of ṣaṣ 'six'
pūrvādikoṇeṣu = eastern-corner; locative plural of compound pūrva+ādi+koṇa 'eastern corner'
ṣaḍaṅgāni = six-limbs; accusative plural neuter, object of worship
samarcayet = should-worship; optative third singular active of sam-arc 'to worship'
